question: Which of the following statements is correct about Article 43 B of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: It was added in the 44th Constitutional Amendment.
It is related to cooperative society.
It is related with the right of livelihood.

solution:
The correct answer is__** It is related to cooperative society.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 43 B **is related to **cooperative societies.**
 
• It directs the state to promote the** formation** and **autonomous functioning** of cooperative societies.
 
• The objective is to ensure the democratic functioning of cooperatives based on principles of **voluntary formation, democratic control, and autonomous management.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 43 B was **not **added to the 44th Constitutional Amendment.

 
 
• The **44th Amendment Act of 1978** dealt with various other provisions of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• The **right to livelihood** is enshrined in **Article 21** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 43 B was **not** added in 2002.
 
 
• Article 43B was added to the Indian Constitution by the **Constitution (Ninety-seventh Amendment) Act, 2011.**
